conjoin.para: Conditions conjoin rather than replace: a second condition narrows the stage to the logical AND of both, it does not overwrite the first. To widen instead of narrow, pass a single whenAny { } block.

ceRestriction.para: A custom operation cannot sit under an if or a match inside a computation expression. A stage that needs to branch must build the value first and apply the operation unconditionally.

envVar.para: An EnvArg with an empty Values list is satisfied by the variable merely being set. When Values is non-empty the current value must be one of them, and an optional EnvArg is satisfied whether or not the variable exists. An empty name throws.

gitBranch.para: The branch is read with git branch --show-current in the stage's working directory. If git is missing or fails, the message is printed and the condition evaluates to false rather than throwing — so a branch-gated stage is skipped, not failed, outside a checkout.

platformNote.para: Evaluated on the machine running the pipeline via RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform, not at compile time.
